title: perityle tenella
intro: Perityle tenella, commonly known as Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant is used for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Perityle tenella are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, making it an effective remedy for wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Perityle tenella include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
